verdict.rationale: Canva's docs describe design generation and editing from natural language via its MCP server (canva-docs-17, canva-docs-18, canva-docs-28, canva-docs-33), which lets AI assistants create and modify designs from text descriptions and specifications, plus discovery, export, and asset management. However, this capability is delivered through an external MCP integration/AI connector rather than a native in-editor 'Magic Design'-style prompt feature, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming quality of generated mockups. Missing for 10: first-party in-product documentation of native prompt-to-design (e.g., Magic Design) generation, independent hands-on verification of output quality, and confirmation this works without third-party AI tool setup.
